text: The fix is one word: app: ingest becomes app: grain-ingest. The real work is making sure a mistake like this can never ship silently again.
The NetworkPolicy moves into the same Helm chart as the Deployment, both reading one shared label value -- there's no longer a second file anyone can forget to check.
A new CI step renders the chart and fails the pull request outright if any NetworkPolicy's selector ever disagrees with a Deployment's pod labels again.
We add a synthetic health check too -- a real, periodic connection attempt to Azure SQL, alerting directly on a connectivity gap even if no pod ever crashes.
We trigger a fresh autoscale event and watch pods, cost, and database load all rise together, with zero telemetry gap -- confirmed on the exact dashboard that caught this in the first place.
